open-source is frontier on legal!

[IDÉZETT POSZT, amelyet clem 🤗 megosztott. Eredeti szerzője: Harvey (@harvey); megjelent: 2026-11-24T16:05:05+00:00; link: https://x.com/harvey/status/2125259420259250209; média: nincs média]
US open-weight models have caught up.

We post-trained four US models from @meta, @nvidia, @reflection_ai and @thinkymachines with the Harvey Tenet recipe we used on Kimi K3.

They are now competitive with non-US models, and Muse Spark Open is the first model to pass 30% all-pass on Legal Agent Bench.
